details.boundaryOrTradeoff: A script executing in the authorized page shares its code trust boundary. Removing the vendor script prevents it from reading the confidential page DOM; event minimization alone is insufficient.
details.errorCorrection: A script executing in the authorized page shares its code trust boundary. Removing the vendor script prevents it from reading the confidential page DOM; event minimization alone is insufficient.
details.mechanismOrProperty: Scripts running in the document page can inspect its DOM; event minimization does not constrain that access. Remove vendor code from the confidential page.
details.scenarioApplication: A case portal renders confidential documents. The browser page also includes vendor JavaScript. Which single decision most directly prevents vendor code from receiving confidential fields?
details.transfer: If the actor, resource, session, or stated product policy changes, reconsider the decision from the new evidence.
